propositions: Mutation gate hard-fails with exit code 2 when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent from the checked-out patchset tree (i.e., change is based on a commit older than the one introducing the script).
The gate produces Verified -1 that reports nothing about the change's actual quality when it fails due to missing script.
Sibling gates (env-var registry gate, comment hygiene gate) already guard against this scenario by checking for script existence and skipping cleanly with explanatory messages.
Mutation gate must skip cleanly (exit 0) when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent, matching the guard pattern used by sibling gates.
The gate must still execute for real on changes based at or after the commit introducing the script, without becoming a silent bypass.
